verdict.rationale: Abacum is an FP&A platform, so variance explanation is a fair axis. However, nothing in the pack documents explaining budget-to-actual or period-over-period variances. The closest items are adjacent features rather than variance analysis: generic AI answers inside the model, investor-report narratives that update as actuals flow in, drill-down to source data, and budgets alongside live actuals. None of them states that the platform identifies or explains the drivers of a variance.
